page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-8x.48xlarge is a high-density, GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance built on KVM hypervisor architecture. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs driven by x86_64 Intel Xeon 8469C processors running at a base frequency of 2.6 GHz. The platform is provisioned with 1024 GB of system memory, providing roughly 5.33 GB of RAM per vCPU. Compute capacity is paired with 8 attached graphics processing units containing a combined 768 GB of GPU VRAM.

Networking performance is anchored by a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps, enabling rapid data transfer for distributed workloads. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, necessitating the attachment of external block storage volumes for persistent data operations. This architectural choice decouples compute and storage resources, allowing independent scaling of disk performance and capacity, though it introduces reliance on network storage latency for disk IOPS.

Resource allocation targets large-scale enterprise artificial intelligence and compute-heavy parallel processing tasks. With 768 GB of total VRAM and 192 dedicated CPU threads, the instance supports consolidated execution of deep learning training, massive LLM fine-tuning, large batch inference, and high-performance scientific simulations. The high resource density offers qualitative cost efficiency by packing significant compute and accelerator capabilities into a single virtual host, eliminating multi-node communication overhead for workloads fitting within these hardware boundaries.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-8x.48xlarge is a dedicated GPU-accelerated server instance designed for compute-heavy parallel workloads and machine learning deployment. Operating on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization, it integrates 192 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8469C processors running at 2.6 GHz, along with 1024 GB of system memory. Hardware acceleration is provided by 8 GPUs delivering an aggregate VRAM capacity of 768 GB. The instance provides 100 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth to handle large-scale data ingestion and inter-node communication. Local disk storage is omitted, requiring external network-attached block storage for operating system and application data. This high-density resource profile maximizes qualitative cost efficiency by consolidating intensive parallel computing tasks on a single host, minimizing inter-node latency. It is suited for large language model inference, deep learning model training, enterprise AI pipelines, and complex scientific simulations.
